name: GLOBAL baseline coverage90
definition: covered90 components / all GT components achieved by the frozen global baseline on the clean-v3 FULL_FIELD population

name: ORACLE REGION coverage90
definition: covered90 components / all GT components achieved with GT-derived regional crops
notes: the clean-v3 upper bound; must NOT be copied from the v2 value 1.000000

name: PREDICTED REGION coverage90
definition: covered90 components / all GT components achieved with GT-free predicted proposals
notes: the quantity Phase 13 exists to measure

name: Refiner potential
notes: denominator of the retention ratio; if G <= 0 retention is undefined and the gate must report NO_GO / REVISE rather than a ratio

name: Proposal retention fraction
notes: historical v2 value was exactly 0.500000; the clean-v3 value is a CANDIDATE, not a threshold, until the supervisor freezes it

name: GLOBAL full-field Dice
definition: macro Dice of the frozen global baseline

name: ORACLE REGION full-field Dice
definition: macro Dice with GT-derived regional crops

name: PREDICTED REGION full-field Dice
definition: macro Dice with GT-free predicted proposals
notes: the historical v2 value was 0.383905 and drove the Phase-14 Step-3 failure

name: architecture scope
definition: R and G must be reported for ALL FOUR frozen baselines, not a single architecture
notes: no reference model is selected; heterogeneity must be visible

name: primary retention metric
definition: coverage90-based retention on the re-derived clean-v3 hard sets, with the Dice-based retention reported alongside
notes: the historical contract used coverage90 only; reporting both is more informative
